name: Benagil, Marinha Valleys, Carvoeiro & Silves Castle Tour
tagline: The Moorish capital of the Algarve and the Algarve's most spectacular coastal grottos — Silves Castle, Benagil and the sea caves in one day from Albufeira
overview: This full-day tour from Albufeira combines the finest Moorish fortress in Portugal with the Algarve's most spectacular coastal scenery. Begin at Silves Castle — a vast red sandstone citadel built by the Almohad dynasty in the 12th century when Silves was the capital of the Moorish kingdom of al-Gharb, more populous than Lisbon — then explore the sea-sculpted limestone landscape of the Marinha Valleys and the famous Benagil sea cave system before finishing at the clifftop village of Carvoeiro. Note: Silves Castle entry is approximately €2.80 per person, payable on site (optional but recommended — the castle interior is the highlight).
highlights: Silves Castle — the finest surviving Moorish fortress in Portugal, a vast red sandstone citadel built by the Almohad dynasty in the 12th century as capital of the Algarve
Marinha Valleys — a dramatic coastline of limestone arches, sea stacks, and hidden coves carved by the Atlantic, best seen from the clifftop path
Benagil sea caves — the Algarve's most photographed coastal formation, with natural cathedral vaulting and a beach accessible from the sea
Carvoeiro — a whitewashed clifftop village above a small beach, one of the prettiest stretches of the central Algarve coast
Expert guide covering the medieval history of Silves and the Moorish kingdom of al-Gharb

itinerary.description: Drive inland from Albufeira to Silves, following the Arade River valley into the hills. The castle appears above the orange groves on the hillside — a circuit of massive sandstone walls with eight towers, a deep cistern, and views over the town and valley below. Your guide explains the remarkable story of Silves under Moorish rule (711–1242): a city of 30,000 people with running water, libraries, and tile-decorated palaces at a time when most of Europe was in the early Middle Ages. The castle was taken by Crusader forces in 1189 and finally conquered by Afonso III in 1242. Castle entry: approximately €2.80 per person, payable on site (optional).
itinerary.extra_fee: Silves Castle entry approximately €2.80 per person — payable on site, optional

itinerary.description: Head south to the Marinha coastline — a stretch of eroded limestone cliffs, natural arches, sea stacks and hidden coves that represents the finest section of the Algarve's central coast. Walk the clifftop path above the sea for panoramic views of the carved limestone formations, with the Atlantic spreading to the south. The Marinha area has won multiple Blue Flag beach awards and is consistently ranked among the most beautiful coastal landscapes in Europe.

The Benagil sea cave system is one of the most extraordinary natural formations on the Algarve coast — a series of limestone grottos carved by Atlantic wave action, with cathedral-scale vaulted chambers open to the sky through a collapsed roof. The most famous chamber contains a beach of fine golden sand accessible only from the sea. View the cave system from the clifftop above Benagil — one of the most photographed natural sights in Portugal — or arrange an optional kayak or boat excursion from the beach below to enter the caves from the water.

Finish at Carvoeiro, a small whitewashed clifftop village built around a beach cove, with restaurants and cafés on the waterfront. The village is characteristic of the traditional Algarve fishing coast and a good point for a final coffee or lunch before the return to Albufeira.

included: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Albufeira
excluded: Silves Castle entrance fee (approximately €2.80 per person — optional, payable on site)
Optional boat or kayak tour at Benagil (paid separately on site)
meeting_point: Hotel pickup from Albufeira (confirm address at booking). Return by evening.
tips: Silves Castle's entry fee is approximately €2.80 and is absolutely worth it — bring small change for the ticket office
The Benagil cave interior is only accessible by boat or kayak from the beach — the clifftop view is free and spectacular, but book a boat trip in advance if you want to enter
Silves is much quieter than Albufeira and Faro — the castle has almost no queues even in peak season
Medronho — a firewater distilled from arbutus berries unique to the Algarve hills — is sold in small shops in Silves old town

faqs.question: Is Silves Castle entry included in the tour price?
faqs.answer: No — Silves Castle entry is approximately €2.80 per person, payable on site. The GYG listing describes it as optional, but the castle interior is the centrepiece of the day and is strongly recommended. Bring a few euros in cash for the ticket office.

faqs.question: Can I enter the Benagil sea caves on this tour?
faqs.answer: The tour includes the clifftop viewpoint above Benagil, which gives spectacular views of the cave system and the surrounding coastline. Entering the caves requires a boat or kayak from the beach below — these are run by independent operators and can be booked separately on site. Ask your guide on the day for current operators and pricing.

faqs.question: Is Silves Castle open every day?
faqs.answer: Silves Castle is open daily year-round, including weekends and public holidays, from 9am to 8pm in summer and shorter hours in winter. The tour timing ensures you arrive during opening hours.
